title: pt2 archives must be validated before torch.export.load when pickle deserialization is disallowed
answers: pytorch pt2 model loads with MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION=false
torch.export.load arbitrary code execution from a crafted pt2 archive
pt2 model refused to load when pickle is disabled
body:
Symptom: With MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION=false, a PyTorch model saved with serialization_format="pt2" can still execute code embedded in a crafted archive, or fails to load with no clear reason.
Root cause: mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py:_load_by_pickle_check guarded only the eager torch.load branch; the pt2 branch passed the archive to torch.export.load, which unpickles sample inputs, weights and constants with weights_only=False.
Fix pattern: when pickle is disallowed, run mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py:_validate_pt2_archive_is_pickle_free before torch.export.load. Text/JSON metadata records and raw tensor records marked use_pickle:false pass; every other record must load under torch.load(weights_only=True), else raise MlflowException naming the record.
Constraints: Refuse pt2 on torch < 2.10. Never mutate torch.serialization safe globals (the weights_only unpickler honors them): statically scan each data.pkl with pickletools via _pickle_globals and reject references to user-registered globals, failing closed on unparseable streams. Read only payload-config JSON up front and validate other records one at a time to bound memory. Skipped in Databricks Runtime and Model Serving via _is_pickle_deserialization_allowed.
applies: Any change to the pytorch flavor's pt2 load path or to any loader that calls torch.export.load under the pickle guard.
says: Loading exported PyTorch models still executes arbitrary code despite disabling insecure deserialization.
Hardened security settings fail to block untrusted code execution from exported PyTorch archives.
Exported PyTorch models fail to load when untrusted object deserialization is turned off.
Block malicious code execution vulnerabilities when loading exported PyTorch models in production.
Ensure exported PyTorch model packages load safely under strict no-unpickling security policies.

Text/JSON metadata and use_pickle:false raw tensors pass, while every other record must load under torch.load(weights_only=True) or raise MlflowException naming the record. The validator refuses pt2 on torch < 2.10, statically scans data.pkl files with pickletools via _pickle_globals to reject user-registered globals without mutating safe globals, reads payload-config JSON up front while validating other records sequentially, and is skipped in Databricks Runtime and Model Serving via _is_pickle_deserialization_allowed.
